name: Bell of the Frozen Bolt (Ngưng Lôi Chung)
lore: Cast in 702 from the ice the nuns cut where Hoắc Hàn Quang's tribulation froze the lightning on a northern peak (C039, A105). The ice has not melted in five hundred years. When it is struck it rings with a crack of thunder that never comes. It hangs in the Upper Hermitage and is rung for the dead of Hồ Thiên at each solstice, and every night of the winter of 1199 (A111).
build_use: The abbess's bell rite: heavier Ice stacks and a stun on the canon's count.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Snow Veil Robe (Tuyết Sa Đạo Bào)
lore: Woven of white yak wool and glacier frost by the founder for the abbesses who climb to the seal; it is cold inside, so that the cold outside cannot find the wearer.
build_use: Sustain and cold resistance for a long sit against the seal.

name: Pear Branch (Lê Chi Kiếm)
lore: A thin grey sword with a pear-wood hilt, carried by the prioress of the Gate Hermitage. It is the sword that has turned away every man at the gate since 1020, though it has seldom had to leave its sheath.
build_use: A gate-keeper's sword: blocks and holds Ice stacks for the Pear Blossom thrust.
made_by: the caravan smiths of Trường Vân Thành (before Trấn Sa Đường), for Thái Lê Tuyết's first year as abbess

lore: The miner's coat she was found in on the Gate Hermitage's step, lined with grey nun's cloth and iron thread as she grew.

name: Grey Sisters' Beads (Hôi Ni Châu)
lore: A string of 108 grey beads, one from each sister of the Gate Hermitage who raised her; four of them are dead.
build_use: An oath-bound mind: soul guard and linh lực.
